author: HaloGuardian101
body:
Hello, before I even start this I want to ask why it was removed?
Apart from that can we bring it back
Reasons:
#1. It was my number 1 way of escaping team kills on mesoplanet or when I am underground.
#2. For those who don't play walls its actually quite annoying having to stack up.
#3. It always helped when your team mate was  skybasing so you can do /surface and you are on the skybase.



Cheers Avicus players
-halowarrior101

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
As _Poseidon__ said, by having /surface for donators, we were violating the EULA. So it was removed.

The only way I could see it being brought back is if /surface was available for everyone to use.
(Donators and Non-Donators.)
This way it wouldn't violate the EULA.
But I don't see this happening any time soon.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Mineplex no longer has any shop items that would violate the EULA. It's not Pay-2-Win.
As for Hive theres again, no perks in their store that are Pay-2-Win. They have premium joining but that doesn't restrict normal users from playing, it just means they need to go on another server and they have a lot of them so it doesn't matter.

Servers only premium members can access are just lobbies.

As for Hive's "Extra high quality bandwidth and efficient routing" perk, I doubt it actually works to a point where it could highly improve performance. I've played with 50ms and 300ms ping and while theres a difference, 300 is easily playable if you get used to it.

replies.body: Honestly, it's not bad, just easily abused. You can use it to quickly get chests on top of a high place or get up to a teammate's skybase without much effort.
